cordana.symptoms: Large oval or zig-zag yellow to orange bordered brown necrotic lesions, often advancing along leaf veins.

organic_measures.name: De-leafing & Botanical Spray
organic_measures.method: Prune severely spotted leaves. Spray neem oil formulation (5 ml/L) with soap emulsifier.

chemical_measures.name: Mancozeb 75% WP or Propiconazole 25% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply with mineral oil adjuvant if recommended locally.

prevention_measures: Improve drainage and ensure banana stools are adequately thinned.
Prune excessive suckers to allow airflow.
sources: ICAR-National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB) Trichy

sigatoka.symptoms: Small yellowish streaks expanding into dark brown to black spots with grey centers and yellow halos, coalescing and causing premature leaf death.

organic_measures.name: Sanitary De-leafing & Petroleum / Mineral Oil Spray
organic_measures.method: Cut off heavily infected leaf tips or whole leaves. Apply agricultural grade horticultural mineral spray oil (10 ml/L) to inhibit spore germination.

chemical_measures.name: Tridemorph 80% EC or Propiconazole 25% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear full PPE. Rotate with contact protectants (Mancozeb) to avoid resistance.

prevention_measures: Maintain plantation density at recommended spacing (e.g., 1.8 x 1.8 m or 2.1 x 1.5 m).
Ensure field ditches have good gradient for drainage.

pestalotiopsis.symptoms: Circular or irregular ash-grey spots with dark brown margins, often bearing minute black fruiting bodies.

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply copper hydroxide (2 g/L) on affected foliage.

chemical_measures.name: Carbendazim 50% WP or Mancozeb
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Avoid runoff into waterways.

prevention_measures: Avoid mechanical injury to banana leaves during cultivation.

banana_healthy.symptoms: Large broad green intact leaves, robust pseudostem, no spotting or leaf tear.

organic_measures.name: Organic Mulching & Bio-fertilizer
organic_measures.method: Apply banana pseudostem mulch and vermicompost around root zone.

prevention_measures: Continue periodic desuckering and sanitary weed management.
